_comment: Used-EV specialist retailers surveyed 2026-08-24 — independents whose lot is (or was) all-electrified, none of them crawled before. Rows in registry.json's own shape so they can be folded in by hand; registry.json is hand-curated and is never written by this lane. `_registryChange` on each row says what the hand-edit is: `add` for a domain the registry has never held, `update` for one it already has. Probe verdicts below were written by `node probe.mjs --sites-file out/evspecialists-new-sites.json`.

sites.name: Recharged
sites.notes: Used-EV specialist, Richmond VA + reconditioning/experience centres in Charlotte, Jacksonville and Fairfax. All-electrified lot. Next.js: the SRP renders no cars and the VDP's schema.org rides in a <meta name="script:ld+json"> rather than a <script>, so the generic stack extracts zero. Whole lot from /api/trpc/vehicle.search (robots allows /api). lib/platforms/recharged.mjs. | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-24: recharged tRPC vehicle.search, 412 vehicles

_crawl2026_08_24.note: 74 of 412 withheld: 73 isReserved (the site still counts them and their VDP has no buy path) + 1 sold/unknown status

sites.name: Ever
sites.notes: All-EV retailer, Costa Mesa + San Francisco CA. Largest unbuilt independent found so far. Already in registry.json as needs-investigation with six identical probe notes ("0 VIN vehicles in 12 fetches ... leads: nextjs"); this row REPLACES that one. Its /api is robots-disallowed and stays shut — the door is /cars itself, which server-renders its own search result with the page size in a JSON-encoded `f` parameter. lib/platforms/evercars.mjs. | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-24: evercars server-rendered /cars search, 1130 vehicles

_registryWas.note: probe 2026-08-19: 0 VIN vehicles in 12 fetches (0 ItemList entries, platform unknown) — client-rendered or API-backed; leads: nextjs

_crawl2026_08_24.note: 471 of 1130 withheld as PURCHASE_IN_PROGRESS — rendered "Reserved / Get notified if it becomes available", no buy path. 16 of the 659 live cars are BEVs classifyEv did not admit: Genesis GV60 x13, Genesis Electrified GV70 x1, Jaguar I-Pace x1, and one whose model string is bare "Porsche Macan" on an all-EV lot. Over the full 1130 the same gap also covers VW e-Golf and a bare "Lexus RZ" with no trim number. EV_MODEL_RE nameplate gaps — not this lane's file to edit.

sites.name: Plug In Auto
sites.notes: West Covina + Costa Mesa CA. Founded as a plug-in specialist; the lot has since gone mixed (339 cars, 108 electrified + 4 hydrogen FCEVs, 207 petrol), which makes it this survey's petrol control. Runs DealerSync — a vendor no rooftop in the registry was on. lib/platforms/dealersync.mjs. | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-24: dealersync /Inventory/Search, 339 vehicles

_crawl2026_08_24.note: 110 electrified of 338 live (100 BEV + 8 PHEV + 2 PHEV?); 7 of them abstain on price (FinalPrice 0). 228 not admitted: 207 petrol, 6 non-plug-in hybrids, 4 hydrogen Mirais, diesels — the petrol control

sites.name: Get Used Tesla
sites.notes: Fresno CA, Tesla only. Runs the Vehica WordPress theme; its VDPs carry no JSON-LD at all. Whole catalogue from WordPress's own REST API. Small live lot (15 of 413 records) — the other 398 are SOLD by the theme's own Offer Type taxonomy, and the site still counts them in the "413 Results" it prints. lib/platforms/vehica.mjs. | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-24: vehica WordPress REST feed, first page of, 100 vehicles

_crawl2026_08_24.note: 398 of 413 are SOLD by the theme's own Offer Type taxonomy and the site counts every one of them in its "413 Results"

sites.name: eCarOne
sites.notes: Plano TX (Sonic Automotive). Surveyed as a used-EV specialist; measured as a LUXURY pre-owned dealer with a mixed lot that includes EVs (a 2026 Cybertruck on page one of its SRP). Plain dealer.com with server-rendered Vehicle JSON-LD — no new code, it just was never in the registry. Its robots.txt names ClaudeBot/GPTBot/CCBot and friends but leaves the wildcard group open to /used-inventory/ and /all-inventory/. | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-24: 12 VIN vehicles on 1 page(s), platform dealer.com

_crawl2026_08_24.note: Plain dealer.com — the existing dealercom-api lane read it with no new code. 98 EVs of a 227-car luxury pre-owned lot; the non-EVs are the petrol control

_yield: crawl.mjs on all five, 2026-08-24: 1,204 unique EV listings, every domain complete=true and none truncated. recharged 338 / evercars 643 / pluginauto 110 / ecarone 98 / getusedtesla 15.
